Scientifically Rigorous Reservoir Analysis

Our methodologies are grounded in established rock physics principles and validated through peer-reviewed research. Every recommendation we make can be traced back to fundamental geoscience.

Rock Physics Modeling

Utilize established theoretical models (Gassmann, Biot-Gassmann, Hertz-Mindlin) to characterize relationships between rock properties, pore fluids, and seismic response.

Learn more

Advanced Seismic Inversion

Apply deterministic and stochastic inversion algorithms to transform seismic amplitudes into quantitative estimates of acoustic impedance, Vp/Vs ratio, and reservoir properties.

Learn more

Lithofacies Classification

Employ statistical and machine learning approaches calibrated to well data for probabilistic lithofacies prediction, quantifying uncertainty in reservoir characterization.

Learn more

Feasibility Studies

Assess the detectability of reservoir properties using synthetic seismic modeling and sensitivity analysis before committing to full-scale interpretation projects.

Learn more

Introducing CONFIRM

COnfidence-driven Net reservoir Formation Inversion for Reservoir Mapping

CONFIRM represents our integrated approach to reservoir characterization that combines rock physics, seismic inversion, and statistical analysis to deliver property estimates with quantified confidence intervals. Make better drilling decisions with data you can trust.
